notes: Subscription purchase interface appears to omit its action button; device and purchase-path clarification can support troubleshooting without assuming a charge.
validation_question: Does the missing purchase control describe a malfunction or a subscription navigation question?

notes: Proposes a paid early-access feature for artist releases. Hypothetical pricing does not establish a transaction or billing dispute.
Requests control over frightening advertisement content; no safety allegation or directed abuse is expressed.
Reports a mobile app failure across network connections. A necessary clarification about the failure is eligible for automatic handling.
Objects to catalogue navigation through compilations and newer material; desired browsing improvement is inferable without a reported malfunction.
Requests a refund for an additional student-plan charge while already subscribed; an actual charge requires account-capable human handling.
Expresses dissatisfaction about value with an unavailable link and no describable service issue. Payment wording alone does not specify a billing problem; missing context prevents supported handling.
Reports reaching a download limit and asks for its removal. The explicit download boundary determines intent; current public limit guidance or feedback acknowledgment is eligible.
Requests catalogue-wide random playback as a new feature; no malfunction or material-risk trigger is stated.
Pure praise for prior account assistance is eligible for a bounded acknowledgment, without treating closure as a new support resolution.
Asks how to influence the language of Discover Weekly recommendations. Public recommendation guidance can address this without account intervention.
Asks about bundle eligibility with a Family plan. This is public offer information requiring current approved sources, not an actual transaction dispute.
Reports music unexpectedly stopping with call-like behavior; device and audio-context clarification can support automatic troubleshooting.
An existing artist profile lacks biographical metadata. Treating this as profile information permits public guidance, although third-party missing biography is not an explicit taxonomy example.
validation_question: Should a listener's report of a missing artist biography fall under metadata, or does missing content extend to profile biographies?

notes: Signup hangs with script errors, so the access boundary determines intent. Initial browser troubleshooting needs no account-specific recovery.
Understandable English describes a failed internet-banking payment and seeks money back. Payment failure or refund handling requires a human.
Asks support to identify and restore an unknown track previously removed from a personal playlist; this requests account-specific historical recovery.
Premium access is missing despite a stated prior payment. Money takes priority over the linked-account cancellation question and requires account investigation.
Reports reduced volume after transferring playback between devices. No unknown device or compromise is alleged; audio troubleshooting is eligible.
Reports recurring Mac crashes caused by the app. Repeated failures and emphatic urgency alone do not establish repeated unsuccessful support contact or directed abuse.
Cannot update payment-card details because the payment interface never finishes loading. Payment-details failure falls under the billing boundary and requires human handling.
Requests editorial separation of new albums and singles. This is a categorization preference with ordinary criticism and no escalation trigger.

Questions an apparent second charge after student verification and another card-entry prompt. The expressed duplicate-charge concern needs human billing investigation without assuming the charge is confirmed.
Requests timing for a smart-TV platform app. Considering building an app does not explicitly threaten to leave the service; public platform information is eligible.
Playback stops when another app is opened. Background-playback troubleshooting or device clarification is supported without a material-risk trigger.
Disputes an additional unauthorized charge beyond two expected subscriptions. An unauthorized payment alone does not establish account compromise; billing investigation is required.
Only reports sending a private message; the underlying request is absent. An honest handoff is needed because no support issue can be inferred from the supplied text.
Reports playback not following the requested selection. Clarifying the behavior and plan can distinguish a bug from a Free-tier restriction without assuming either account compromise or billing risk.
Frames difficulty listening as a limitation of using the service without Premium. Public Free-tier guidance and clarification are eligible; a separate malfunction is not established.
validation_question: Does this express Free-tier playback restrictions, or a general app malfunction whose details are omitted?

notes: A Premium user cannot access music offline. The problem is offline playback, with no stated payment dispute or account-recovery request; download troubleshooting is eligible.
Requests edge-to-edge screen support for a device. The explicit screen-support boundary treats this as a feature request eligible for public information or acknowledgment.

Objects to absent explicit-content controls after children heard profanity. No legal or safety allegation, staff insult, or churn threat is stated; exasperated profanity alone does not require escalation.
Proposes an additional preference signal beyond saving a song. This is a new feature request rather than a broken library action.
Wants to disable an unwanted lyrics-related interface feature. Public settings guidance is eligible; the taxonomy lacks an explicit category for general feature-settings how-tos.
validation_question: Should a request to disable an unwanted interface feature use feedback when no malfunction is reported?

notes: Reports a prepaid payment card no longer being accepted. This is an actual payment failure, not a general supported-payment-method question.
Asks about an absent album. Capitalization and urgency do not create an escalation trigger; public availability guidance or regional clarification is eligible.

Confirms earlier advice resolved the problem and praises the helper. A disconnected chat is not repeated unsuccessful contact when the issue is explicitly resolved; bounded acknowledgment is eligible.
Needs access or closure for an account tied to a nonexistent Facebook identity. Account recovery or closure under inaccessible credentials requires human intervention.
Demands an app fix to resume listening. A necessary technical clarification is eligible; incidental profanity is not a directed insult or evidence of repeated failed support.
Cannot access the account and has not received password-reset mail. The combined access and failed recovery request warrants account-specific recovery assistance.
A Family-plan invitation fails with an error. Public invitation troubleshooting or clarification is eligible; the message does not yet require identity verification or account-specific intervention.
Directly disputes duplicate charging, requiring a human with billing access.

Requests an offline view limited to downloaded albums. The explicit downloads/offline boundary determines intent even though the requested remedy is a feature; public filter guidance or feedback handling is eligible.
Sarcastically reports a service-unavailable error. The text supplies a recognizable technical problem despite an unavailable link; incidental profanity does not constitute directed abuse.
Fans request adding an artist to the catalogue. Public availability guidance or clarification of the redacted artist identity is eligible without artist-account intervention.
Asks how to remove radio entries from personal recent listening. This is a library/radio management question eligible for current public guidance.
A single unexplained term and unavailable link do not identify a support issue. Missing context requires an honest handoff.
Reports trouble using a gift card and explicitly requests a telephone support contact. The payment/redemption issue takes routing priority over the human-contact request.
The Mac app remains loading for an extended period after recent instability. Technical troubleshooting is eligible; repeated app trouble is not repeated unsuccessful support contact.
Pure gratitude supports a bounded acknowledgment. An accompanying unavailable link does not prevent interpreting the complete social closure.
